title: Nourishing Herbal Venezuelan Beef Empanadas
description: A traditional Venezuelan dish featuring shortcrust pastry filled with herbal beef, perfect for a weeknight dinner. The use of render-fat and raw-friendly ingredients adds to its nutritional value.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the rendered beef fat over medium heat.
Add the ground beef to the skillet, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Once the beef is browned, add the chopped cilantro, parsley, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
Roll out the shortcrust pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Use a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass to cut out circles of pastry.
Place a tablespoon of the beef mixture onto the center of each pastry circle.
Fold the pastry in half over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Place the empanadas in a terracotta dish, leaving about 1 inch of space between each empanada.
Bake the empanadas in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
